title: Pilot native evidence reuse for Git publication admission

intentCoverage.report:
**Caught.** The existing assertion rejects a false completeness claim after a failed historical Git-tree lookup.

- **Story and revision:** `SEED-262#pilot-admission-native-evidence-reuse`, revision `fdf39429159f48d11f2f844a41a3da1db3d84d8c`. The selected source is `.planning/seeds/SEED-262-faster-dashboard-test-feedback.md#pilot-admission-native-evidence-reuse`; plan `.planning/slice-plans/544-pilot-admission-native-evidence-reuse/PLAN.md` requires read failures to leave comparison incomplete, never an empty difference. A passing current assessment cannot fill missing historical facts.
- **Fault:** In `tests/support/native-admission-reuse-identity.mjs:143`, moved the existing `differences.complete` calculation outside the historical `git ls-tree` try/catch. This plausible error lets manifest validity mark comparison complete despite a failed historical lookup. Fixtures and assertions were unchanged.
- **Fixture and reach:** `tests/support/native-admission-reuse-gap-cases.mjs:29` supplies an unavailable Git object (`f` repeated 40 times) and omits the retained `VERSION` hash. Before reaching the selected assertion, the case successfully asserted assessment `pass`, unrecorded `VERSION`, the `historical source tree unavailable:` gap, and `added: []`. Thus the observed wrong behavior was on the intended failed-lookup path.
- **Maintained assertion:** `tests/support/native-admission-reuse-gap-cases.mjs:46` requires `differences.complete === false`, with message `unknown source history cannot establish no added inputs`. The fault run failed there with `actual: true`, `expected: false`, exit 1; the named failing subcase was `unavailable Git object`.
- **Runs and restoration:** Used an isolated detached worktree at the selected revision, its own locked `npm ci` dependencies, Bash 5.3.20 first on PATH, and confirmed AC power. All three runs used `PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH caffeinate -s -i bash scripts/test.sh tests/support/native-admission-reuse.test.mjs` (seven top-level cases plus three historical-source subcases). Baseline passed; the intentional fault was caught; restoration passed. The source was restored automatically in `finally`, then verified byte-for-byte, with clean Git status and unchanged revision after the restored run. Target SHA-256 before/after: `8c6d475de531b0022f05699b329fdce249dff0e31cb7e42db724abc87b31f3e1`. Only the owned scratch worktree and external probe artifacts were removed. The execution checkout was untouched.

- **Test runtime.** 56.2 seconds total (measured from the maintained runner's per-job timing): baseline 22.0 s, fault 16.1 s, restored 18.1 s.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable: no separate human-effort measurement was supplied or collected; no human intervention occurred during the check.
- **Agent effort.** Unknown/unavailable: no separate agent-effort measurement or token accounting was exposed. Wall-clock elapsed is reported separately below.
